import Foundation
import UIKit

/// A greeter.
/* block /* nested */ comment */
@MainActor
public final class Greeter: NSObject, Greeting {
    @objc dynamic var name: String = "world"
    private(set) var count = 0
    static let shared = Greeter(name: "x")

    var greeting: String {
        get { "Hello, \(name)!" }
        set { name = newValue }
    }

    init(name: String) {
        self.name = name
        super.init()
    }

    deinit {
        print("bye")
    }

    func greet(_ who: String? = nil, times: Int = 1) async throws -> String {
        let target = who ?? name
        let raw = #"raw \#(target) "quoted" \n"#
        let multi = """
            line one
            line \(times)
            """
        guard times > 0 else { return "" }
        let total = count
            + times
            - 1
        let ok = total == 2
            && times != 3
            || false
        if let x = who as? String, !ok {
            return x
        }
        let forced = try! String(contentsOfFile: raw)
        _ = (multi, ok, forced)
        return target
    }

    subscript(index: Int) -> Character {
        return Array(self.name)[index]
    }
}

protocol Greeting {
    associatedtype Output
    func greet(_ who: String?, times: Int) async throws -> String
}

struct Point: Equatable {
    var x: Double; var y: Double
    static func + (lhs: Point, rhs: Point) -> Point { Point(x: 1, y: 2) }
}

infix operator <*>: AdditionPrecedence
func <*> (a: Int, b: Int) -> Int { a * b }

enum Direction: String, CaseIterable {
    case north, south
    case east = "E"
    indirect case other(Direction)

    var opposite: Direction {
        switch self {
        case .north: return .south
        case .south: return .north
        default: return self
        }
    }
}

extension Greeter {
    func wave() -> some View where Output == Int {
        do {
            try something()
        } catch is NSError {
            print(1)
        } catch {
            print("other")
        }
        return EmptyView()
    }

    struct Nested<T: Hashable> {
        typealias Key = T
        let key: Key
    }
}

typealias Callback = (Int) -> Void
let x = 3 <*> 4
